title: Pentimento (Nothing Painted Over)
summary: A self-deflating artist's statement whose every correction is real <del>/<ins> markup the browser keeps struck-through and legible — the pentimento worn on the surface instead of buried.
mechanism: HTML <del>/<ins> semantic edit elements rendered by the user-agent stylesheet: the deleted words stay in the DOM (display:none toggles the 'finished' reading) and ride along in textContent, so every clipboard copy carries the correction.
references: Robert Rauschenberg, Erased de Kooning Drawing (1953)
Walter Benjamin, The Work of Art in the Age of Mechanical Reproduction (1935)
